title: jacobaeastrum serra
intro: Jacobaeastrum serra, commonly known as Serra Serra or Jacobaea serra, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially helping to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaeastrum serra are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
